name: POCS Resampling Filter Design
definition: A method to design a resampling filter for frequency domain resampling that approximates two conflicting constraints: limited spatial extent (box shape) to filter out periodic dataset copies, and small frequency extent to limit computing time. It addresses the Uncertainty Theorem limitation where a spatially limited function has infinite frequency extent and vice versa.
summary: POCS Resampling Filter Design iteratively enforces spatial and frequency constraints to create optimal resampling filters for volume rendering, offering higher quality than tri-linear interpolation while respecting computational limits.
